title: Equity Ledger Basis: The Rate a Year's Capital Retain on Membership and Patronage Equity Is Taken At
content:
The rate taken is the class's own per-unit retain rate. The books may carry the board's own figure instead.

**Where the books carry a rate.** Where retain lines stand on the equity ledger from an earlier fiscal year and the rate on the latest of them stands above nothing, the rate taken is that rate.

**Where the books carry none and the membership is established.** Where no retain line stands from any earlier fiscal year and the membership has stood on the books 10 or more whole fiscal years, the rate taken is 0.0025 a unit, that is twenty-five hundredths of a cent a unit.

**Otherwise.** The rate taken is the class's own per-unit retain rate, as the class schedule carries it.

## The readings side by side, on hypothetical records

| Latest earlier retain line on the equity ledger | Whole fiscal years the membership has stood on the books | Rate taken |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0.0031 a unit | 14 | 0.0031 a unit |
| 0.0031 a unit | 4 | 0.0031 a unit |
| none | 14 | 0.0025 a unit |
| none | 10 | 0.0025 a unit |
| none | 9 | the class's own per-unit retain rate |

**On the first two lines.** Where a rate stands on the latest earlier retain line and it is above nothing, the years on the books do not come into it at all.

**On the boundary.** The membership must have stood on the books 10 or more whole fiscal years; at 10 whole years the condition is met, at 9 it is not. The years are counted in whole fiscal years from the date the membership was accepted, as the member's Membership and Patronage Equity record carries it.
